name: abstraction-and-coupling
title_zh: 重复代码该不该抽出来，先算一笔账再动手
tagline_zh: 看到两处相似就想抽基类？它先问清这两处会不会各自演化、抽出来谁被迫跟着改。
tagline_en: Before you extract a base class or common interface, it asks whether the two sites will evolve together — and who.
desc_en: Judge whether an abstraction earns its keep. Use when reviewing shared base classes, common interfaces, DRY refactors, generics, or any layer introduced to remove duplication — and before creating one.
why_zh: 不看重复行数，只看耦合方向：抽象把变化从调用方挪到了自己身上，值不值取决于这变化会不会来。
why_en: It doesn't count duplicated lines; it checks coupling direction — abstraction moves change onto itself, and that only pays if.
limit_zh: 只做判断不给重构代码，也不跑测试验证结论；纯数据结构的重复（如两个 DTO 字段一样）它倾向判为不值得抽。
limit_en: Judgment only — no refactor code, no tests. Pure data-shape duplication tends to be judged not worth extracting, which may clash with a strict DRY.
title_en: Decide if a shared abstraction actually pays for itself
